mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1200K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and SPX correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when both triggers are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals decreased economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real disposable personal income (RSAFS) above $480B signals increased consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and retail sales
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS > 480B, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals a monetary-fiscal policy mix boost, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when both triggers are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased wage pressures.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between UNRATE and wage growth
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 240 signals decreased inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between CPIAUCSL and inflation expectations
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 240, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
